metadata.title: Public Database of Backlink Spam Doorway Domains, Link-Selling Networks, and Checkout Link Abuse (2026)
metadata.description: Empirical classification of backlink spam doorway domains, link-selling networks, and checkout-link abuse (17,000+ websites carrying shared checkout links across 5+ domains) compiled by Jason Zhu. Live interactive blacklist and detection rules available at https://jasonzhu.ai/en/backlink-spam-list.
